items.title: Ellen Rowe interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 2, 2024
items.q: Oh please give him my best. We miss him. I can’t wait to hear how things are going for him and to catch up with him

ctx.x: Yeah. Some of the things I’d really love to do, of course I want to keep playing, I would like to do more playing and really be able to have some multi nights in a row where you can really develop a rapport with your group. So I’d like to be out playing more and I’m hoping this new quartet album, once I finally pick the tracks and get it mixed and all that, may help promote that. I love doing composer residencies where maybe you have a commission or a school decides they want to play a couple of your pieces and…
I bet it will. Gabe Condon says hello.
Oh please give him my best. We miss him. I can’t wait to hear how things are going for him and to catch up with him, and I’m just so happy he landed there.
